label: ft_un_rep
definition: Per test segment s and reference token type v: B=min(count in base hyp, count in ref), F=min(count in fine-tuned hyp, count in ref), lost L=max(0,B-F), gained G=max(0,F-B). ForgetGenUse_X = sum L / sum B over (s,v) with v in X. ID = types occurring >= id_min_count times in the fine-tuning set's target side under the same tokeniser; OOD = the rest. _macro = mean over types of X with sum_s B>0 of sum_s L / sum_s B. Copy splits: v also in the source segment (same tokeniser) or not. Operationalisation of Saunders & DeNeefe (2024) Sec 2.1 as described in groundwork.json's saunders2024 note; Eq 1's exact normalisation is to be checked against the paper.
